1. Query: what position $i$ seeks; key: what $j$ offers for matching; value: content mixed if $j$ is selected.
2. $\alpha_{ij}=\exp(s_{ij})/\sum_{j'}\exp(s_{ij'})$.
3. $c_i=\sum_j\alpha_{ij}v_j$.
4. Softmax yields fractional weights, not a single hard index.
5. No — $\alpha_{ij}$ are computed from current $q,k$; the learned parts are mainly $W_Q,W_K,W_V$ (and embeddings).
